export_vlm_model: export a vision-language model (VLM) like SmolVLM2 for ExecuTorch by exporting vision encoder, connector, and text decoder components
export_decoder_lm: export a decoder-only language model for ExecuTorch using static or hybrid cache with torch.export
export_seq2seq_model: export a sequence-to-sequence language model encoder and decoder separately for ExecuTorch with static caching
generate_text_exported: generate text from an exported model program by feeding input tokens and iterating with cache positions
register_dynamic_cache: register DynamicCache as a pytree node so it can be exported with torch.export for ExecuTorch compatibility
